cohort: 1410 pregnant women were recruited in Australia during pregnancy (<=24 weeks gestation).
finding: Women reporting low childbirth knowledge, a preference for caesarean section, high childbirth fear (W-DEQ), and depressive symptoms (EPDS) reported lower childbirth self-efficacy, regardless of parity, though multiparous women generally had higher self-efficacy.
mod_finding: Women who preferred a caesarean section reported lower self-efficacy.
